WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    t.transref,
    tr.tradekind AS trader_type,
    AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN transactionrecord AS t
    ON t.transreg = s.transref
  JOIN trader AS tr
    ON tr.tradereg = t.trdref
  GROUP BY t.transref, tr.tradekind
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS mean_anlycount
  FROM pair_averages
),
kept_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    p.trader_type,
    p.avg_anlycount,
    p.avg_anlycount - m.mean_anlycount AS margin_over_mean
  FROM pair_averages AS p
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
  WHERE p.avg_anlycount > m.mean_anlycount
),
type_averages AS (
  SELECT
    trader_type,
    AVG(avg_anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
    AVG(margin_over_mean) AS avg_margin_over_mean
  FROM kept_pairs
  GROUP BY trader_type
)
SELECT
  trader_type,
  avg_anlycount,
  avg_margin_over_mean,
  avg_anlycount / AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS relative_to_mean_across_trader_types
FROM type_averages;
